answer:
**Max Verstappen ran Intermediates, then three sets of Softs** in his 3-stop win for Red Bull Racing at the 2026 Bahrain Grand Prix (held at Sepang, Malaysia). He did not use Mediums.

• **Stint 1 (Laps 1–9)**: **Intermediate (Green)** — started on intermediates after a ~40-minute rain delay.
• **Stint 2 (Laps 10–33)**: **Soft (Red)** — pitted on Lap 9 under the Safety Car as the track dried.
• **Stint 3 (Laps 34–43)**: **Soft (Red)** — pitted on Lap 33.
• **Stint 4 (Laps 44–55)**: **Soft (Red)** — pitted on Lap 43 under the neutralisation for Albon's stop, then held off Antonelli to win.
